nina_cs: Quick pulse on KestrelLabs hosted account spend — commit $20k/mo. Weekly burn looks off: $9.3k with an overnight spike flagged +130% day-over-day. Anyone see a traffic change?

spend-alert-bot: ALERT: KestrelLabs (hosted) spend anomaly +130% vs baseline. Severity: medium. https://alerts.redwood.internal/evt/2134578910

ryan_ops: Checking logs now. There's a 45m window (01:10-01:55 UTC) where chunked streaming requests jumped x4. Suspect client toggled high-frequency telemetry. Query link: https://metrics.redwood.com/q/kl-spike

leo_data: I'll add a quick client_id and route split to the dashboard and export top 5 client ids. Give me 12m.

sara_onboard: I'm on with the PM — they shipped a streaming analytics feature to 10% of users last night. They thought traffic would be minimal. Asking them to roll back the flag.

matt_billing: Current projection if spike persists: commit used in ~11 days, then overage. Recommend temporary throttle and notify finance. I'll open tracking ticket FIN-889.

ryan_ops: Applied soft throttle: `PATCH /internal/accounts/kestrellabs/caps {"daily_token_cap":140000}` and a rule to downgrade verbose_streaming connections. No service errors observed so far.

leo_data: Dashboard updated: https://dash.redwood.com/boards/kestrel-spend  client_alpha accounts for 78% of burst. Snapshot posted.

sara_onboard: Message sent to PM: "We've applied a temporary throttle and paused the experimental stream. We'll share a breakdown and options (rate limits, batching, Dedicated)." They acknowledged.

nina_cs: Recap: throttle applied, customer paused feature, analytics board added, billing ticket opened. Schedule a 30m touch tomorrow to recommend next steps (commit increase vs Dedicated). Closing unless further alerts.
